messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER — edge-vpc-01 GPU pool queue growth detected (>8000 requests queued). Autoscaler attempted scale but failed with repeated node provisioning timeouts. Possible customer-side constraints. Paging oncall.

sanjay: ack. I'm oncall. grabbing logs now. what customer clusters are affected?

IncidentBot: Affected: cust-acme-east-1 (private), cust-labs-eu (vpc). Error: 'node creation failed: quotaExceeded' for the cloud provider in acme account; for labs-eu error trace shows kubelet imagePullBackOff repeatedly during init.

maria: on my way. quick note — traffic routing shows a slowshift to fallback model variant, but front-end is still sending 40% of requests to the private pools.

jamie: seeing the same in the console. token latency for cust-acme-east-1 jumped from 120ms to >2.3s; 5xxs up ~12% over last 12m. customers are being degraded.

sanjay: immediate mitigation options: 1) enable emergency-burst capacity profile for acme (if permitted), 2) throttle inbound to private pools via rate-limiter, 3) manually provision warm nodes via cluster API. Which should we try first?

leo: we should throttle first to stop queue growth while we provision. ops-bot, can we apply a temporary route rule to divert 50% of traffic for cust-acme to hosted fallback?

ops-bot: Command queued: apply route override for customer=cust-acme -> fraction=0.5. ETA ~ 40s. :gear:

sanjay: doing throttle in frontdoor now — reducing concurrency for private endpoints to 0.5 of normal.

maria: meanwhile I'm invoking manual node create for the acme private cluster. kubectl output: 
```
# provisioning via cluster-api
kubectl apply -f acme-warm-node.yaml
# monitor
kubectl get machines -n cluster-acme -w
```

maria: logs show node bootstrap stuck on image pull for ca-image:v2.4. Error: EOF while downloading layer. suspect registry throttling.

jamie: can we switch the image to our mirror? acme cluster has egress blocked to external registries sometimes.

maria: yes patching daemonset to use internal-mirror/ca-image:v2.4 now.

IncidentBot: ops note — autoscaler last 10 attempts failed with reason: insufficient quota (acme) and imagepull backoff (labs-eu). Autoscaler backoff timer now 15m.

sanjay: I'm opening a quota request ticket to cloud provider for acme account (high priority). ID: CLOUD-8472. Also raising infra ticket to add mirror fallback for future bootstraps. 

customer-sre: we alerted the customer's SRE via DM and opened a bridge. They're confirming they don't have spare quota and are OK with a temporary diversion to hosted.

leo: hosted fallback will increase cost for now but reduces customer-visible errors. ops-bot, proceed with fraction=0.75 for 10m if queue doesn't fall below threshold.

ops-bot: route override updated: customer=cust-acme -> hosted_fraction=0.75 for 10m.

jamie: queue dropped ~65% in 4m after diversion and throttle. 5xx rate falling. good.

maria: manual nodes for acme successfully joined, but taints from profile prevented pods from landing until toleration applied. applying toleration patch.

sanjay: apply toleration:
```
kubectl patch deployment redwood-inference -n inference --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"tolerations":[{"key":"warm-only","operator":"Exists","effect":"NoSchedule"}]}}}}'
```

maria: pods are now scheduling and starting KV cache warmups. latency trending back toward baseline.

IncidentBot: Customer impact summary (automated): 12.4% request failures, increased P95 latency to 2.3s, incident duration ~36m so far. Severity: P1. Next steps: hold until quotas confirmed or autoscaler recovers, postmortem runbook.

customer-sre: Customer wants a short blameless update: explain that we throttled and diverted traffic and are provisioning warm nodes; no data loss, some degraded availability during window.

sanjay: drafting customer message now. tagging product-ops and cs to approve.

jamie: quick note for runbook — need an autoscaler fallback that can detect registry failures and try mirror images before backing off. filing FR: INF-1293.

leo: also add proactive warm node buffer for private clusters with small quotas. policy suggestion.

maria: once quota ticket CLOUD-8472 is resolved we'll revert route override and remove throttle. leaving monitoring alerts on for 2 hours after revert.

sanjay: handing off to maria — I'm going to sleep but will be reachable. maria, you're primary. :hand:

maria: ack takeover. I'll keep the bridge open for 1hr to ensure stabilization and then create follow-up postmortem doc. Thanks everyone.

ops-bot: Incident updated: owner=maria, severity=P1 -> monitoring, bridge closed to non-essential participants.

sanjay: Thanks team. postmortem owners: maria + jamie. timeline and mitigations to be captured in postmortem doc.

maria: closing notes: immediate mitigation steps executed: 1) throttle private traffic, 2) route 75% to hosted fallback, 3) manual warm node provisioning, 4) toleration patch to allow scheduling, 5) opened CLOUD quota ticket and infra FR for mirror fallback. Impact: partial degradation for ~36m, customer informed. will follow up with RCA and corrective actions. :white_check_mark:

IncidentBot: Incident closed to pager rotation. Please file a postmortem within 72 hours.
